units.text:
Allowable vibration levels on
DESMI centrifugal pumps and motors
As standard DESMI centrifugal pumps with electric motor generate less than 2.8 mm/s vibration velocity (measured
in 3 directions at motor flange level on vertical pumps) during a factory test.
units.display_text: Allowable vibration levels on DESMI centrifugal pumps and motors As standard DESMI centrifugal pumps with electric motor generate less than 2.8 mm/s vibration velocity (measured in 3 directions at motor flange level on vertical pumps) during a factory test.

source_spans.text: As standard DESMI centrifugal pumps with electric motor generate less than 2.8 mm/s vibration velocity (measured
in 3 directions at motor flange level on vertical pumps) during a factory test.

units.text:
The pump and electric motor industry generally agrees that vibration levels above 7 mm/s are damaging – i.e. this
will result in shorter lifetimes of e.g. bearings and/or shaft seals in pumps (and bearings in motors) than normally
expected.
units.display_text: The pump and electric motor industry generally agrees that vibration levels above 7 mm/s are damaging – i.e. this will result in shorter lifetimes of e.g. bearings and/or shaft seals in pumps (and bearings in motors) than normally expected.

units.text: This agrees with the recommendations in the international standard ISO 10816-3.
units.display_text: This agrees with the recommendations in the international standard ISO 10816-3.

source_spans.text: This agrees with the recommendations in the international standard ISO 10816-3.

units.text:
But in pump installations on ships external excited vibrations from main engine and/or auxiliary machinery are
transferred from ship hull to the pump often resulting in much higher vibration velocities than 7 mm/s.
